abstract: We study differential-geometric calibration and correspondence projection of Weil classes on abelian $2m$-folds alongside explicit complete-intersection realizations of exceptional Hodge classes on Fermat varieties $X_d^4 \subset \mathbb{P}^5$, $X_{12}^2 \subset \mathbb{P}^3$, and $X_6^{2p} \subset \mathbb{P}^{2p+1}$. First, via the principal-angle decomposition on $\mathrm{Gr}(m,2m)$, we prove that every graph $m$-plane $\Gamma_B$ satisfies $|\langle P_{\Gamma_B},\Psi_\pm \rangle| = |\det B|/\det(I_m+B^\dagger B) \leq 2^{-m}$ (with equality iff $B \in \mathrm{U}(m)$) and obeys the Maclaurin inequality $\mathrm{Tr}_{E_k}(P_W)+\mathrm{Tr}_{E_{m-k}}(P_W) \geq 2\binom{m}{k}|\langle P_W,\Psi_\pm \rangle|$. Second, averaging sign-adjusted graphs $\Gamma_{-g} = \{w+gz=0\}$ over the special monomial group $G_m \subset \mathrm{SU}(m) \cap \mathrm{SL}_m(\mathbb{Z}[i])$ of order $4^{m-1}m!$ plus coordinate subtori yields an effective cycle $\mathcal{Z}_{\mathrm{eff}}^{(m)} \geq 0$ on $E_i^{2m}$ ($m \geq 2$) whose Hodge locus is the $m^2$-dimensional Weil PEL domain $\mathfrak{H}_{\mathrm{Weil}}(\phi)$. Third, we prove $i\partial\bar{\partial}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Weil}}(B(z)) = \gamma_Z^*(\omega_{\mathrm{Pl\ddot{u}cker}})$, forcing a qualitative calibration deficit $\Delta_{\mathrm{curv}}(Z)>0$ on simple Weil varieties, and construct an $(m+1)$-point rational Chebyshev-Weil projector $\Pi_{\mathrm{Cheb}}^{(m)} \in \mathbb{Q}[\mathrm{End}_{\mathbb{Q}}(A_\tau)]$ onto $W_{\mathrm{Weil}}(A_\tau)$, reducing the Hodge conjecture for $W_{\mathrm{Weil}}(A_\tau)$ on a simple fiber to a seed cycle with non-vanishing Weil period. Fourth, building on the Catalecticant rank theorem of Dan, Villaflor Loyola, and Kloosterman and the sextic realizations of Braun et al., we derive closed-form factored $6 \times 6$ Jacobians for general even-degree ($d=2m \geq 6$) double-Aoki-Shioda surfaces $Z^{(2m)} \subset X_{2m}^4$ and $Z_{\mathrm{nonic}} \subset X_9^4$. Fifth and sixth, at $d=12$ we construct weighted Brieskorn-Pham curves $C_{\mathrm{spor}}, C_{S_1,S_4} \subset X_{12}^2$ and entangled surfaces on $X_{12}^4$ (ranks $1605, 2653, 3018$) directly realizing $S_4, S_1$, and all $7$ pair-free orbits on $X_{12}^4$, and prove the Mod-3 Block Decomposition Law on $X_6^{2p}$.
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: Fixes all three algebraic typos noted in the referee report on revision DyQ00ZMGg99rgsk1 in Theorem 5(d), test_hodge_loci_engine.py, and exp24_dodecic_cubic_entangled_pf01_and_s1.py: (a) Set g_{cub,3} := P_4 + Ptilde_4 and h_{cub,3} := P_4^2 - P_4 Ptilde_4 + Ptilde_4^2 so that g_{cub,3} h_{cub,3} = P_4^3 + Ptilde_4^3 and g_{cub,1} h_{cub,1} + gtilde_{cub,1} htilde_{cub,1} + g_{cub,3} h_{cub,3} = sum_{i=0}^5 x_i^{12} with 2x2 Jacobian d(g_{cub,3}, h_{cub,3})/d(P_4, Ptilde_4) = -3(P_4 - Ptilde_4) and P_{Z_{cub}^{(12)}}(x) = +3(P_4 - Ptilde_4) Jhat_3(x_0, x_2, x_3) Jhat_3(x_1, x_4, x_5); (b) Corrected the intermediate exponent in Stage 2 of the proof of Theorem 5(d) to (-beta^3 - 3)x_2^{12} = x_2^{12} at beta^3 = -4; and (c) Stated and verified that the non-inductive terms of P_{C_{S_1, S_4}}(x) on X_{12}^2 have orbit support {S_1 = (1, 4, 9, 10), S_4 = (1, 6, 8, 9), S_6 = (2, 6, 8, 8)}. Relative to Version 1 (i66iHiK1cDmNsF_4), this Version 2 update also addresses all minor notes from the Version 1 acceptance report and strengthens Theorem 5 with the two-stage cubic-remainder Brieskorn-Pham syzygy (exp24): (1) Verified and unified all full 4x4 and 6x6 Jacobian determinant signs in Theorems 4 and 5 (+8i m^4 for P_{Z_{semi}^{(2m)}}, +12i x_1^5 J_3 for P_{C_{spor}}, and -2i for P_{Z_{spor,std}^{(12)}}); (2) Added Theorem 5(d) establishing the two-stage cubic-remainder syzygy x_0^{12} + x_2^{12} + x_3^{12} = g_{cub,1} h_{cub,1} + P_4^3 at beta^3 = -4 (with 2-variable Jacobian factorization J_2(x_0, x_3) = det d(A, Q_6)/d(x_0, x_3)), yielding C_{S_1, S_4} subset X_{12}^2 and Z_{cub}^{(12)} subset X_{12}^4 (Catalecticant rank 3018) so that all 7/7 pair-free orbits on X_{12}^4 are directly realized by explicit complete intersections; (3) Distinguished sorted S_6-permutation classes (8, 10, 8, 44, 118) from S_6 x (Z/dZ)^x Galois orbits (4, 4, 2, 11, 39) across d = 6, 8, 9, 10, 12 in Section 1, Theorem 4, Theorem 5, and Table 2; (4) Clarified rational Hdg^2(X_6^4, Q) generation ([23, Theorem 1]) and Z[1/6]-generation ([23, Theorem 2]) in Proposition 1 and updated Reference [19] to Miranda, Movasati, Rufino, and Villaflor (arXiv:2609.27301v1, 2026); and (5) Clarified dual tangent contraction in Section 3, positive semidefiniteness outside ker(d gamma_Z) and qualitative Delta_{curv}(Z) > 0 in Section 4(b)-(c), and rational quasi-endomorphisms in Section 4(d).
title: Calibrated Geometry of Weil Classes, Double-Monomial $\mathrm{SU}(m)$ Designs, Chebyshev Endomorphism Projectors, and Closed-Form Jacobians of Entangled and Sporadic Complete-Intersection Cycles
